notes.title: Development Update: A New Chapter Begins
notes.content:
Development Update: A New Chapter Begins

Grandis Adventures is entering an exciting new stage of development,  
and we’re incredibly grateful to have you with us on this journey.

We’ve prepared something special —  
exclusive behind-the-scenes content, future plans,  
and a look at what’s coming next.

To learn more, visit the website linked on our store page.

Thank you so much for being part of this adventure.  
Your support truly means the world!

notes.title: Check out dynamic parkour action at Grandis Adventures!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

- energetic jumps and spins
- Beautiful vast open world
